svg.text: Every builder returns one branchSpec per field, so A.MapWithIndex gives a flat slice. A.Chain joins the four groups into one 19-item slice.

svg.text: appendFullSearchMerge adds the merge block with A.Push(merge). S.Join("\n") then joins the 19 bodies and the merge into one statement.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 539-line AQL statement: 19 LET search branches, then the merge tail. The text is the same for every search; only the bind parameters change.
